subject: No signal after new graphics card
description: Installed an RTX 4070, monitor says No Signal on HDMI. Old card worked fine.
resolution: Customer was on HDMI 2 but input set to HDMI 1. Selected correct input, works.

subject: MacBook Air M2 does not detect monitor via USB-C
description: Plugged USB-C from MacBook Air M2, nothing shows. Charging works.
resolution: Customer used phone charging cable. Supplied cable fixed it.

subject: Flickering at 165Hz in games
description: Screen flickers black for a second in games at 165Hz using DP.
resolution: Driver 560.94 regression. Updated to 565.90, flicker gone.

subject: USB-C not working with macOS Sequoia
description: After updating to macOS 15 the monitor stays black over USB-C, worked on macOS 14.
resolution: Known firmware 1.0.6 handshake bug. Updated firmware to 1.0.8, fixed.

subject: Bright dot in centre of screen
description: Bought 10 days ago, one green dot always on in the middle.
resolution: Zero Bright Dot within 30 days. RMA created.

subject: Speakers not working
description: No sound from the monitor speakers, HDMI connected to PC.
resolution: Windows output was set to laptop speakers. Selected monitor as output.

subject: Touch not responding after Windows update
description: Touch stopped working after Windows 11 24H2 update; display fine.
resolution: Known issue with HID driver on 24H2, workaround: reinstall touch driver 3.2. Linked to Jira.

subject: Firmware update stuck, amber LED blinking
description: Update failed at 60 percent, now power LED blinks amber and no picture.
resolution: Escalated to L2 for service-mode recovery; recovered remotely.

subject: Black screen for 2 seconds when game starts
description: Every time a game launches, the screen goes black then comes back.
resolution: Normal mode switch when refresh changes. Advised to set desktop to 165Hz too.

subject: HDMI no signal from PS5
description: PS5 shows nothing, PC works on same port.
resolution: PS5 HDMI handshake: disabled Auto Input Detect and set HDMI 2 manually.

subject: Monitor turns off randomly every few minutes
description: Monitor powers off by itself after 5-10 minutes of use, power LED goes off.
resolution: Eco mode auto power off bug in firmware 1.0.7, fixed in 1.0.8.

subject: Second monitor not detected on MacBook Air
description: Two TD2455 on MacBook Air M1, only one works.
resolution: M1 Air supports one external display. Recommended DisplayLink dock.

subject: Several dark pixels near the edge
description: 3 dark pixels near the bottom edge.
resolution: Below dark-pixel threshold (5, or 2 in central zone). Not eligible; explained policy.

subject: Colours washed out with HDR
description: When HDR is enabled in Windows the image is grey and washed out.
resolution: Customer had HDR on with brightness 30. Advised HDR mode in OSD and the Windows HDR calibration app.

subject: No audio over DisplayPort adapter
description: Using DP to HDMI adapter, no sound.
resolution: Adapter dropping audio; native HDMI cable fixed it.

subject: Touch stops after sleep
description: Touch works after boot but not after the PC wakes from sleep.
resolution: Known: USB selective suspend. Workaround: disable USB selective suspend; fix pending in DISP-455.

subject: Monitor not powering on at all
description: No LED, no picture, tried another socket and cable.
resolution: Power board failure. RMA created under warranty.

subject: Vertical line across screen
description: A thin vertical pink line appeared, visible in all inputs and in OSD.
resolution: Panel defect (line visible in OSD). RMA created.

subject: USB-C laptop charging stops
description: Laptop shows slow charger warning on VX2780 USB-C.
resolution: Laptop needs 90W; VX2780 provides 65W. Expected behaviour, explained.

subject: Monitor shuts down after 10 minutes
description: Display switches itself off after ten minutes even while working.
resolution: Firmware 1.0.7 eco-mode bug. Updated to 1.0.8.
